y-m-11-05.s.s2.explain: Umgca wesi-4 yingxaki. Imigca ye-1~3 ichanekile ngenene kwiimeko ezimbini zeepensile nomjikelezo. Ukujonga nje itheyibhile enye, yokuhambisa okanye yendawo, kubonisa ukuba akuphindaphindwa kabini.
